trial_title: FLARE Lupus Research Study Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
brief_summary: The first phase of this pilot study will assess changes in quality of life at the end of a 16-week Mymee program in patients with moderate to severe SLE. The second phase will assess changes in healthcare utilization and cost over a one year period after program end.

eligibility_table.criterion: ≥ 18 years of age who can consent for themselves
Location - U.S.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is located in the U.S.

eligibility_table.criterion: Proficient in English (speaking, reading, and writing)
eligibility_table.justification: There is no indication that the patient is not proficient in English.

eligibility_table.criterion: Own or have reliable access to a smartphone (iPhone or Android)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient likely has access to a smartphone, as it is common for individuals in this demographic.

eligibility_table.criterion: Provision of medical record
eligibility_table.justification: The patient can provide medical records as part of standard care.

eligibility_table.criterion: Diagnosis of Lupus SLE as indicated in medical record
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has systemic mastocytosis, not Lupus SLE.

eligibility_table.criterion: Symptomatic lupus as indicated by a score of at least 6 on one or more of BPI-SF questions 3, 5, or 6 and/or a score of at least 3 on one or more of the first four questions on the FACIT
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about the patient's scores on BPI-SF or FACIT.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a score of at least 6 on one or more of the BPI-SF questions 3, 5, or 6, or a score of at least 3 on one or more of the first four questions on the FACIT?

eligibility_table.criterion: Current prescription for one or more of the following medications: 20mg/day of oral prednisone (or other oral corticosteroid equivalent dose); methotrexate and/or other immunosuppressive therapy of any dosage such as cyclophosphamide (Cytoxan®), methotrexate (Rheumatrex™), or azathioprine (muran®), adalimumab (Humira Pen, Humira Pen Crohn's-UC-HS Start, Humira Pediatric Crohn's Start, Humira, and Humira Pen Psoriasis-Uveitis), Plaquenil, Cellcept; monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) such as Benlysta® (belimuab, formerly called LymphoStat-B™); rituximab (Rituxan, MabThera and others)
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is not on any of the specified medications for lupus.

eligibility_table.criterion: Able and willing to consent to study protocol
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is 22 years old and can consent to the study protocol.

eligibility_table.criterion: Medications which have been stable for 3 months
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's medications have changed recently due to a steroid taper.

eligibility_table.criterion: Pregnant and/or planning to get pregnant before end of 16-week intervention
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about the patient's pregnancy status.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient currently pregnant or has she confirmed plans to become pregnant before the end of the 16-week intervention period?

eligibility_table.criterion: In prison during any part of the 16-month study period
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is not in prison.

eligibility_table.criterion: Resident of a nursing home, wards of the state, or Institutionalized during any part of the 16-month study period
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is not a resident of a nursing home or institutionalized.

eligibility_table.criterion: Persons with decisional incapacity/cognitive impairment
eligibility_table.justification: There is no indication of decisional incapacity or cognitive impairment.

eligibility_table.criterion: Participating in another clinical trial, interventional or observational research during the study period
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is not participating in another clinical trial.

eligibility_table.criterion: Plan or intention to receive/start during the 16-week (112 day) intervention period either:
eligibility_table.justification: There is no plan or intention to start any new treatment during the intervention period.

eligibility_table.criterion: a standing dose of oral steroid agents at a 20mg dose of prednisone (or other oral corticosteroid equivalent dose);
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is on a taper of prednisone, which may exceed the exclusion criteria for oral steroid agents.

eligibility_table.criterion: pulses or tapers of steroids for flares for more than a total of 30 days within the observation period
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has been on a steroid taper, which may exceed the 30-day limit for flares.

eligibility_table.criterion: any pulse/taper dose of steroids during the last 4 weeks of the intervention period;
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is currently on a taper of steroids, which may violate the exclusion for steroid use in the last 4 weeks.

eligibility_table.criterion: immunosuppressive agents, or biologic response modifiers.
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is on immunosuppressive agents (steroids), which are excluded.

eligibility_table.criterion: Diagnosed with cancer
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has not been diagnosed with cancer.
